slot.subtopic: Cross product and angle between vectors
slot.brief: Use the cross product of two vectors to find the sine of the angle between them, given their dot product.

stem: For $\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+2\hat k$ and $\vec b=2\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k$, given that $\vec a\cdot\vec b=8$, the sine of the angle between them is
working:
$\vec a\times\vec b=2\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k$, so $|\vec a\times\vec b|=\sqrt{17}$.
$|\vec a|=|\vec b|=3$.
$\sin\theta=\dfrac{|\vec a\times\vec b|}{|\vec a||\vec b|}=\dfrac{\sqrt{17}}{9}$.

Independent check: |a|=|b|=3 and a·b=8, so cos θ=8/9. Thus sin θ=√(1−64/81)=√17/9.
solution:
Using $\sin\theta=\dfrac{|\vec a\times\vec b|}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$, with $|\vec a|=|\vec b|=3$ and $|\vec a\times\vec b|=\sqrt{17}$,
$$\sin\theta=\frac{\sqrt{17}}{3\cdot3}=\frac{\sqrt{17}}{9}.$$
